qa.method: round trip: every written atlas, Aseprite JSON, SpriteFrames .tres, scene .tscn and Sprite3D contract was parsed back and compared with the source frames (exact RGBA), integer durations, loop flags, events and the shared anchor
notProven: Imports into the Aseprite, Godot 4, Phaser, PixiJS and Unity editors or runtimes were not run; only parse-level round trips were checked.
Engine import settings (filter, compression, mipmaps) are not written; set them as engine-export.md describes.
Animation quality, timing feel and silhouette consistency are not judged.

provenance.body_processing: Complete pose style edit, hard alpha threshold128, whole-frame registration. Heavy uses one fixed242/384 nearest scale across all angles. No anatomical cut/warp.

canonical_identity.source_roles: Walk0 alone determines identity, pixel detail and baked shading; other sheets are original pose-layout references.

provenance.animation_constraint: 73 frames/9 clips; preserve all original tick/event/loop metadata and4 fireball PNGs. Heavy redesigned with crouch, pivot step, tail coil/lag and catch-step instead of upright rigid rotation.
